definitions.explanation: The youngest daughter in a family. Often carries connotations of being spoiled or pampered, as the baby of the family.

examples.japanese: {末娘|すえむすめ}が{結婚|けっこん}した。
{三人|さんにん}{姉妹|しまい}の{末娘|すえむすめ}として{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: She grew up as the youngest of three sisters.

examples.japanese: {末娘|すえむすめ}は{家族|かぞく}みんなに{可愛|かわい}がられて{育|そだ}った。
examples.english: The youngest daughter was raised being doted on by the whole family.

notes:
Compound of {末|すえ} (end, last) + {娘|むすめ} (daughter).

RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
- {末息子|すえむすこ}: youngest son
- {末|すえ}っ{子|こ}: youngest child (regardless of gender)
- {長女|ちょうじょ}: eldest daughter
- {次女|じじょ}: second daughter
- {三女|さんじょ}: third daughter

CULTURAL NOTE:
The youngest child in a Japanese family is often seen as being spoiled or pampered ({甘|あま}やかされる). {末|すえ}っ{子|こ} carries this nuance more strongly than {末娘|すえむすめ}.

USAGE:
{末娘|すえむすめ} specifically means the youngest daughter, not just any young daughter. A family could have a {末息子|すえむすこ} who is younger than the {末娘|すえむすめ}.
